Those who are seeking a career in computer systems design or research, or are interested in pursuing graduate programs in computer science, should look into the Bachelor of Science in Computer Science-Combined program at the University at Albany can help students achieve their goals.

This bachelor’s program will teach students to design, build, and test sophisticated software systems and install them on computer platforms; work with and design software systems involving databases, modeling, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, communication, and information retrieval; and solve problems by working with programming languages, data structures, and algorithm analysis.

Program Highlights

  • Develop a commitment to professional and ethical computer science standards as well as a devotion to the life-long learning of new trends in computing, information, and technologies
  • Experience computer science in the work environment through internships and co-ops
  • Tackle global and societal issues with diverse and exceptional faculty who are passionate about advancing both theoretical and practical knowledge in the field of computer science
  • Receive personal attention through academic and career advisement
  • Explore a wide range of courses and programs outside of computer science in humanities, social science, music and the arts
  • Engage in the University’s Honors College
  • Save on tuition compared to that at most private universities.

If you're interested in combining analytical skills with technology expertise to excel in the data-driven business world, the Master of Science in Business Analytics program at UAlbany is the ideal choice for you.

Our program equips you with innovative techniques to analyze large data sets to gain business insights and inform strategic decision-making. You will explore pertinent subjects such as statistics, data privacy, data mining, data visualization, big data analytics and business intelligence.

You will be well-prepared for an in-demand data management career in areas including finance, marketing, accounting, retail, supply chain, human resources, information systems and management.

With its solid foundation in computer science theory and practice, the Master of Science in Computer Science program at the University at Albany is an excellent preparation for a career in computer systems design, software engineering, and applications of computers, or for pursuing a doctorate degree.

Through coursework and hands-on experience in areas such as intelligent systems, information security, software engineering, computer networks, and data mining, students will gain the necessary training to meet their professional goals in occupations that require advanced knowledge of computer theory and technology.

Master the theories and applications that enable machines to learn and make predictions. Whether students want to work with big data in a corporate setting or craft their own algorithms as a technology pioneer, the master’s in data science program will equip students with the knowledge, skills and support to achieve their professional ambitions.

Students will learn how to acquire, process, analyze and present complex data to make better management and policy decisions in industries like biotechnology, energy, quality control, transportation, telecommunications and politics.

The accelerated MBA track is the fastest path to a student's career goals. Students will build on fundamental business concepts and conduct career-focused research in their choice of concentration. In addition, students will gain practical skills through hands-on experiences in real business settings.

Concentration options include cybersecurity, entrepreneurship, finance, human resource information systems, information systems and business analysis, and marketing.
